name: agentic-sdlc
description: An enforced agent-based SDLC pipeline that runs on any coding agent: specify, review, branch, implement, verify, review, gate, land, release. Each stage is owned by one agent and closed by a receipt bound to a commit. Claude Code, opencode, Codex and Cline refuse a skipped stage at the tool call; Gemini denies by policy; Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf and 20+ AGENTS.md hosts get the pipeline plus git-hook and CI enforcement. One adapter file per project; speaks OpenSpec or PRD/FRD.
